topics.title: Meaning and types of internal trade

concepts.learning_objective: Explain internal trade as buying and selling within a nation's boundaries, free of customs and import duty.
Distinguish wholesale trade from retail trade and explain why intermediaries are needed.

topics.title: Wholesale trade and services of wholesalers

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the nature of wholesale trade and the functions wholesalers perform in distribution.
Identify the services that wholesalers render to manufacturers.
Identify the services that wholesalers render to retailers.

topics.title: Retail trade and services of retailers

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that retailing is the sale of goods and services directly to ultimate consumers, however and wherever it is made.
Identify the services retailers render to manufacturers and wholesalers.
Identify the services retailers render to consumers.

topics.title: Itinerant retailers and fixed shop small retailers

concepts.learning_objective: Classify itinerant retailers such as hawkers, market traders, street traders and cheap jacks.
Describe fixed shop small retailers such as general stores, speciality shops, street stalls and second-hand shops.
Explain the features, advantages and limitations of departmental stores.
Explain the features, advantages and limitations of chain stores or multiple shops.
Compare departmental stores and multiple shops on location, range, services, pricing and customers.

topics.title: Mail order houses, consumer cooperative stores, super markets and vending machines

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how mail order houses work and which goods suit them.
Describe the formation, management, advantages and limitations of consumer cooperative stores.
Describe the working of super markets and vending machines and the goods they suit.
Explain GST as a destination-based tax with CGST, SGST, IGST and input tax credit.
State the key features of GST and the constitution and voting of the GST Council.

topics.title: Role of commerce and industry associations in promotion of internal trade

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why associations such as FICCI, CII and ASSOCHAM are formed and how they promote internal trade.
Identify the areas in which chambers of commerce and industry intervene with the government.
